prompt: Our shop front end is built with Vite (installed). React changes far less often than our own code, so in the production build put `react` and `react-dom` into their own chunk named `vendor` (the emitted file should be `dist/assets/vendor-<hash>.js`), while our application code stays in the entry chunk. Do it in vite.config.js and make sure `npx vite build` succeeds.
